scripts.lint: bun run --parallel --no-exit-on-error lint:ruff format:check lint:deptry lint:config lint:type-boundaries lint:type-boundaries:tests lint:architecture lint:vulture type-check:src lint:basedpyright lint:annotations lint:source-rules
scripts.check:core: bun run --parallel --no-exit-on-error type-check:src lint:type-boundaries:src lint:architecture lint:basedpyright lint:annotations lint:source-rules
scripts.lint:fix: uv run ruff check --fix src/ tests/ evaluation/ notebooks/ && bun run format && uv run python scripts/checks/validate_config.py --fix
scripts.lint:ruff: uv run ruff check src/ tests/ evaluation/ notebooks/
scripts.lint:type-boundaries:tests: uv run python -m scripts.checks.check_type_boundaries --select CUSTOM001 --select CORE001 --select CORE002 tests
scripts.format: uv run ruff format src/ tests/ evaluation/ notebooks/
scripts.format:check: uv run ruff format --check src/ tests/ evaluation/ notebooks/
scripts.lint:source-rules: uv run ruff check src --no-fix --select FBT001,FBT002,PGH003
